the donor genotype of rs11139417 in the NOTCH4 gene intron and the recipient genotype of rs213210 and rs17213692 in the RING 1 gene promoter and the HLA-DOB intron, respectively, may serve as the candidate markers for predicting the risk of relapsed disease for patients with leukemia after receiving HSCT.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the SNPs of rs11139417 in NOTCH4 gene and rs79327197, rs2070120, rs2009657, and rs213210 in HLA-DO, -DOB, LTA, and RING1 gene are the potential markers for selecting the best candidate donors for HSCT in patients of AML and ALL.
SNPs within the HLA region can be used as a predictor for the risk of relapsing disease after HSCT in patients who have AML or ALL.
the SNPs located in the HLB region may be associated with the risk of post-transplantation relapse for patients who received HSCT.
